title: Ollaya – Ollama for open-source, Jev-style decision models
summary: Ollaya is an open-source project that extends Ollama's capabilities specifically for decision-making AI models, enabling developers to run and deploy Jev-style decision models locally. The project gained significant traction on Hacker News with 487 points, indicating strong community interest in open-source decision-making AI solutions.
problem_solved: Makes open-source decision-making AI models accessible and locally deployable for developers and organizations.
why_valuable: Democratizes access to decision-making AI by providing an open-source, self-hostable alternative to proprietary solutions.
